reports.title: COHERENT CORP. REPORTS FIRST QUARTER FISCAL 2027 RESULTS

guidance.heading: Business Outlook – Second Quarter Fiscal 2027(1)
section: • | Revenue for the second quarter of fiscal 2027 is expected to be between $2.55 billion and $2.75 billion.
• | Gross margin percentage for the second quarter of fiscal 2027 is expected to be between 40% and 42% on a non-GAAP basis.
• | Total operating expenses for the second quarter of fiscal 2027 are expected to be between $430 million and $450 million on a non-GAAP basis.
• | Tax rate for the second quarter of fiscal 2027 is expected to be between 18% and 20% on a non-GAAP basis.
• | EPS for the second quarter of fiscal 2027 is expected to be between $2.28 and $2.48 on a non-GAAP basis.
